text: The plan declares concurrent-event-source concerns not applicable, but later changes the benchmark runner to create/dispose an AbortController and timeout per repeated run and continues after asynchronous failures. Add the required concurrency-safety section covering the seven checklist items, including timer cleanup, sequential-run re-entrancy, failure/output ordering, and async error propagation.
rationale: Real defect: the flagged lines changed in 1342218, the next commit. Ronda v0.2.0 posted no matching finding on this head. Plan PR counted in scope: Ronda reviews plan PRs and reports no findings. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
